evidence.quote: alr-20261022-0107 | 2026-10-22T06:00:00Z | date_consistency | Data quality check: 508 orders with run_date 2026-10-20 have an order_ts outside 2026-10-20 (UTC) | open | NULL
evidence.why: Shows the alert details about 508 orders with run_date 2026-10-20 having order_ts outside 2026-10-20 UTC.
Shows that the loader uses local timezone bucket instead of UTC, shifting dates across boundaries.

args.root_cause: The pipeline's loader is configured with bucket_timezone: local instead of UTC, which causes orders near midnight to be bucketed into the wrong run_date and triggers the date_consistency check.
args.suggested_fix: Update bucket_timezone in pipeline.yaml from local to UTC to match the pipeline's overall timezone and prevent date shifting.
